_schema: DSv4-Flash progressive wall-time ledger. Perf runs use DUMMY weights + a DEPTH-REDUCED proxy (every DSv4 layer is the identical MoE+MLA+DSA archetype, so wall time is linear in depth). Each iteration records BOTH (a) measured proxy-4 wall time and (b) full-depth wall time derived ANALYTICALLY by depth-scaling. After all ops are integrated, ONE full-depth dummy run validates the analytical prediction. Each op is integrated only after a cosine-fingerprint gate passes. PENDING = not yet measured.

scaling.method: Linear depth model t(L) = t_fixed + L * t_layer. Calibrate t_fixed (non-layer: embed + lm_head + framework/sampling) and baseline t_layer ONCE from proxy4 + proxy8 at step 0: t_layer = (t8 - t4)/4, t_fixed = t4 - 4*t_layer. Per iteration measure proxy4 only; t_layer(iter) = (t_proxy4(iter) - t_fixed)/4; predicted full = t_fixed + 43 * t_layer(iter). t_fixed is config-invariant unless a NON-layer op (e.g. lm_head) is optimized -> recalibrate.

timing_recipe.input: sglang bench_one_batch random DISTINCT token ids -> decorrelated per-token -> MoE routing disperses (avoids broadcast mode-collapse); verify in-engine with plugin/validate/moe_balanced_input policy
timing_recipe.bind: one socket = one NUMA domain, OMP_NUM_THREADS=64 OMP_PROC_BIND=close OMP_PLACES=cores, bound ONCE at init
timing_recipe.measure: bench_one_batch median decode latency (step 0 cold, excluded); DSA ENABLED (ops we optimize); in=2048 out=8; >=3 runs median

integration_gate.metric: per-layer + per-op cosine fingerprint vs reference (torch eager / GPU oracle) on the SAME dummy weights
integration_gate.rule: integrate one op at a time; re-run proxy only after the op's fingerprint gate passes

ledger.label: baseline (unoptimized plugin, all ops torch/donor as-is)
ledger.note: Reference wall time + depth calibration (proxy4 JID 384025, proxy8 JID 384026).

ledger.label: op#7 Lane-A ceiling verification (MLA proj / MoE experts / attn / lm_head)
Phase B: framework / dispatch / OpenMP overhead reduction (ALL ops integrated)
ledger.cosine_gate: bit-exact / cos>=0.9999 (overhead fixes must NOT change tokens)
levers: bind threads ONCE at init (never per-forward set_num_threads -> avoids OMP pool rebuild + affinity loss)
collapse many tiny torch ops into fewer/bigger parallel regions (cut per-op barrier/dispatch count)
OMP spin-wait (OMP_WAIT_POLICY), allocator (tcmalloc/jemalloc), NUMA first-touch, thread-cap
remove dtype-cast / dispatch churn on the hot path
ledger.note: Measured on the fully-integrated proxy AFTER all ops are at roofline. t_fixed (framework/dispatch) and per-layer OMP/dispatch overhead are BOTH attacked here; proxy exposes them at 1/10 depth cost. Show the wall-time improvement, SURFACE it, THEN launch the single full-depth run.

full_depth_validation.when: after all ops integrated (one-off full-depth dummy run, flash-v4.1-dummy, 43 layers)
full_depth_validation.note: Validates the depth-scaling model end to end: measured full-depth vs analytically predicted from proxy4.
